purpose: Teach: 八つ/裁き/如実/無敵/メリハリ/如き/へそ/爺さん

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、八つ当たりするなよ
lines.en: Riku, don't take it out on me just because you're frustrated.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, slightly protective. Sharp enough to land, but not unkind. Eyes steady, one eyebrow up. The tone of someone calling out a friend without fear of losing them.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テストで裁きを受けたな、桜
lines.en: Oh, so you're allowed to bomb a test but I can't mess around with a video game?
lines.style: Wry, deflecting. Quick-paced comeback with a slight smirk underneath. Self-aware that he's being defensive, but committed to the bit. Light, almost playful dodge.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の悔しさが如実に顔に出てたな
lines.en: Yeah, well, your disappointment was written all over your face.
lines.style: Quieter observation. Not mean — just honest. Slight tilt of the head, like she's cataloging what she saw. A moment of genuine seeing, delivered without softness.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ゲームで無敵モード使ってたな、桜
lines.en: Says the person who definitely used infinite lives on that game last week.
lines.style: Knowing smile underneath the words. Caught-red-handed deflection with a thin layer of deniability. Leaning back slightly, comfortable with the accusation landing exactly where intended.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、勉強と遊びにメリハリつけろ
lines.en: You need to learn when to study and when to actually have fun, Riku.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. Speaking from an older-sister place. Conviction without judgment. Slight pause before his name, like the advice matters more than the playfulness.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、彼女の如き優しさを持ってるな、桜
lines.en: You know, you can be surprisingly gentle when you actually try.
lines.style: Soft, genuine praise delivered with a slight edge of vulnerability. The kind of thing he might not have heard often. Warm without being performative. Slight smile at the corner of the mouth.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、夏祭りでへそ出しの服着てたな
lines.en: And showing up to the summer festival in that belly-button shirt — bold choice, Riku.
lines.style: Teasing but with genuine amusement underneath. Slight laughing undertone. Not mocking — more like she's delighted by the audacity. Quick, playful rhythm.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のお爺さん、可愛らしい爺さんだったな、桜
lines.en: Your grandfather seemed like a really sweet old man, by the way.
lines.style: Gentle, sincere shift in energy. Slower pace than before. Tenderness in the voice without saccharine. The kind of thing said quietly, meant to be kept. Slight warmth on 'sweet.'
